concerns.text: T005b (Define EPSILON_SWEEP_VALUES) is listed as a dependency for T025a (Pilot Sensitivity Analysis), but T005a (Pilot Sensitivity Analysis) is listed as a dependency for T005b. This creates a circular dependency: T005a requires T005b to run, but T005b requires T005a to define the values. The pilot analysis (T005a) must run first to validate the range, then T005b defines the final list based on those results.

T035b (Edge case handler) lists T027d (Unified Autoregressive Simulation Runner) as a dependency. However, T027d is the task that *executes* the simulation loop which *calls* the edge case handler. The handler (T035b) must be implemented and available BEFORE the runner (T027d) can be executed or fully integrated. T027d depends on the *implementation* of T035b, not the execution of the runner itself. This reverses the producer-consumer flow for the code artifact.

T031 (Statistical significance test) lists T032 (Theoretical lower bound) as a dependency. However, T031 performs a paired t-test on the *accumulated KL-divergence* scalars derived from T030c2. The theoretical lower bound (T032) is a reference value for comparison (FR-008) but is not a prerequisite for calculating the t-test statistics (mean, std, p-value) of the simulation results. T031 can proceed independently of T032; T032 is only needed for the final report/comparison step, not the statistical test itself.

T001c (Checksumming script) and T001d (Execute checksumming) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) and placed before T001a (Initialize Project Directory Structure). While T001a is marked as 'rejected/incomplete' in the prior review context, the task list itself shows T001c depending on T001a's output (the directory structure). If T001a is not completed first, T001c cannot run. The [P] tag is incorrect here as T001c is strictly sequential to T001a.
